name: IteraCompute
description: Open-model host with a large monthly free token allowance and an Auto router.
overview: IteraCompute serves self-hosted open models through an OpenAI-compatible API and gives every verified account 30,000,000 free tokens per month, shared across qwen/qwen3.8-27b and the Auto routing pool. There is no card, RPM or daily cap — but only one request at a time on the free slot, an 8,192-token output ceiling and no rollover. Prompts are not used to train foundation models without explicit authorisation; the no-recharge promotion currently runs to 2026-11-24.
free_access: 30,000,000 free tokens per month, reset on the 1st
